name: Richard
message: So why're we all the way down in Danish waters, anyhow?

name: Finnegan
message: Didn't yeh hear about her meeting with the Queen?

name: Richard
message: Aye! I heard they're bosom friends now. Close as can be.

name: Richard
message: An' that she refused to acknowledge her as her Queen. There is no Irish queen!

name: Finnegan
message: So long as we don't attack English ships, we're in th'clear for the far future.

name: Finnegan
message: Any other kind o' ship is fine. Including Danish. And gold's gold no matter what flag flies over it.

name: Ophelia
message: (Grace met the Queen of England? The one who was asked to execute Hamlet?)

name: Captain Grace
message: Think I don't see yeh skulking around, eavesdropping right and left?

name: Captain Grace
message: If yeh want t'know about me so badly, you can come ask me yerself!
